# m92-pi - CRT through a VGA666 on the GPIO pins (read by config.txt)
# 240p at 15.72 kHz and 60.01 Hz, as the arcade board: only for screens
# that take 15 kHz (an arcade monitor, a TV through VGA to SCART).
# Each game pixel is 5 DPI pixels wide: the Pi 3 needs a fast clock.
enable_dpi_lcd=1
display_default_lcd=1
dpi_group=2
dpi_mode=87
dpi_timings=1600 1 80 160 280 240 1 3 3 16 0 0 0 60 0 33333333 1
gpio=2-21=a2
